defects.description: Resume rejects only uploading sessions, so a completed upload can become active again.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { UploadSession } from "./src/upload.js"; const s = new UploadSession(); s.start(); s.recordPart("a"); s.complete(1); console.log(`resume=${s.resume()} state=${s.state}`);'

defects.why_missed: The suite resumes a paused session but never delivers a resume after completion; executing the resume branch does not establish its state precondition.

defects.description: Retry copies acknowledgements from the failed attempt, allowing a new attempt to complete without uploading its parts.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { UploadSession } from "./src/upload.js"; const s = new UploadSession(); s.start(); s.recordPart("a"); s.fail(); s.retry(); console.log(`complete=${s.complete(1)} state=${s.state}`);'

defects.why_missed: The retry test fails before any part is acknowledged, so preserving an empty set is indistinguishable from starting fresh.
